title: Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton pack on the PDA in steamy snaps - NewsBreak
text:
By Chiara Fiorillo ,
21 hours ago Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton looked all loved-up as they packed on the PDA in new social media snaps.
The reality TV star , 45, and the British racing driver , 41, confirmed their romance earlier this year and since then, they have shared regular updates with their fans on social media. Kim's latest Instagram post, which she posted on Friday, September 25, is a carousel of some of their recent trips, including a romantic visit to Paris, France.
In one of the snaps she shared, the couple can be seen locking lips while on a boat underneath the Eiffel Tower. The post came days after Kim was awarded $1.15 by a court over the "deeply traumatic" armed robbery she experienced in the French capital 10 years ago.

Kim also shared some photos of herself, wearing a sparkly gold dress, on the Seine River with the iconic monument in the background. Further couple photos the Skims founder shared included a selfie in which Lewis can be seen hugging her, as well as a photo of them lying in bed.
Other photos included a pair of VIP passes to see Celine Dion in Paris, a romantic candlelit dinner and a selfie of Kim on a racetrack, with Lewis zooming past her. The mother-of-four captioned the Instagram post with flags of Spain, Italy, France and the United Kingdom.
Fans were excited to see the couple enjoying their time together, as one commented, "plz get married i love this for u." Another said, "So happy for yall." A third added, "OMG, I'M SO HAPPY THAT MY TWO FAVORITE UNIVERSES HAVE COLLIDED."
"My favorite couple Kimilton," someone else said, as a fan added, "She's living her best life. Go kimmy!!" One more wrote, "You deserve it all kimberly." Charmed alum Alyssa Milano wrote, "You are gorgeous and deserve all this happiness and his eyes are so beautiful."
Another commented, "Happiness looks good on you." A person posted, "Lewis is the luckiest man alive."
Romance speculation initially sparked in January and February when the pair were spotted on a private getaway in the Cotswolds and a weekend trip to Paris. They later fueled rumors with cozy appearances at the Super Bowl and Coachella.
They made their relationship public on social media in June, when Kim posted clips of her riding passenger in Lewis' Ferrari in Tokyo, while the racing driver has since shared his own photos embracing her on vacation.
Their romance has quickly become serious, with the pair blending their families over the summer. Lewis spent time bonding with Kim's children - North, Saint, Chicago, and Psalm - during lake vacations in Idaho and a getaway in Hawaii. Earlier this month, the pair made a highly public appearance at the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art opening night in Los Angeles, where they shared a public kiss on the carpet.
Insiders say the couple, who were longtime friends before dating, are "very serious and committed to their relationship." A source told InStyle, "It is the real deal for Kim and something she hasn't experienced in a long time." The insider added that after a "whirlwind" over the summer, Kim and Lewis are "both extremely busy with work right now."
